meta.title: The economy
meta.question: How do Poles rate the state of the Polish economy?
meta.measure: Average rating of the Polish economy, from 0 (very bad) to 10 (very good)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on the present state of the Polish economy, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.notes: CBOS 1990-01 to 1991-11, 21 surveys, 7-point (bardzo dobra ... bardzo zła with 'raczej' steps).

items.wording: How do you assess the present economic situation in Poland? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-01 to 2017-12, 307 surveys (monthly from 1993). In 2008-05/06 the label is only 'sytuację gospodarczą' (hence the second alternative); value labels separate it from the expectation item.

items.wording: Assessment of Poland's current economic situation
How would you describe the current economic situation in our country? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: Pew, 2002, 2007-2019, 2022-2025: 19 surveys, all with Polish samples.

items.wording: On the whole, how satisfied are you with the present state of the economy in Poland? (0-10)
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2023). Satisfaction with the present state of the economy.

items.wording: How would you judge the current situation of the (national) economy? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: Eurobarometer, 2005-2026, 43 surveys ('SITUATION: NATIONAL ECONOMY'; 'SITUATION: ECONOMY CTRY' in 2005-06). The TCC, EU, world and index variables are excluded.

items.wording: Present state of the Polish economy: dynamic growth / slow growth / slight crisis / deep crisis (SWPS omnibus 2020)
items.notes: SWPS omnibus 2020 (P4). Ordered categories from dynamic growth to deep crisis, an unusual scale; one survey.

items.wording: How do you assess the present economic situation in Poland? (CBOS democracy survey 2021)
On the whole, how satisfied are you with the present state of the economy in Poland? (0-10)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: How would you describe the current economic situation in our country? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.
